script.code:
SELECT CAST(o.item_uom AS CHAR) AS uom, SUM(o.open_qty) AS open_qty,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.doc_no ORDER BY o.doc_no SEPARATOR ', ') AS docs
  FROM on_reserved_gd o
 WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_FLgate.data.tenant}}'
   AND o.is_deleted = 0
   AND o.doc_type = 'Item Assembly'
   AND o.status IN ('Allocated', 'Processing', 'Releasing')
   AND o.open_qty > 0
   AND o.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FLgate.data.org}}'
   AND o.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FLgate.data.plant}}
   AND o.material_id = {{node:code_node_FLgate.data.mat}}
   AND o.bin_location = {{node:code_node_FLgate.data.bin}}
   AND {{node:code_node_FLgate.data.batchCond}}
 GROUP BY o.item_uom

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS id, l.free_token, l.owner_operation_id, l.last_owner_operation_id, l.lock_version
  FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) d
  LEFT JOIN inventory_balance_lock l
    ON l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CLkey.data.tenant}}'
   AND l.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_CLkey.data.org}}'
   AND l.lock_key = '{{node:code_node_CLkey.data.key}}'
   AND l.is_deleted = 0
